name: GSG on cal short: bad GND contact (G lifted)

example.note: One ground tip lifted, as with a probe that is not planarized: the return current takes the other ground alone, adding loop inductance. 70 pH reproduces a lifted-ground TDR Giorgi Maghlakelidze measured (the microstrip case), the same order as published short models for Cascade probes: about 50 pH for GS against 2 pH for GSG. On a short it hides: |S11| stays at 0 dB and the TDR edge moves by about 3 ps. It shows in the phase of S11, about 20° at 20 GHz and 61° at 67 GHz, which this tool does not plot yet.
example.author: TDR Painter
